links.outcome: Comprehension of AI-simplified breast imaging reports by non-healthcare readers
links.effect: Non-healthcare readers showed high comprehension (median 2 for mammography and MRI and 1 for ultrasound); no significant group differences across modalities (p = 0.368), high internal consistency (α > 0.85).
links.quote: Non-healthcare readers showed high comprehension (median 2 for mammography and MRI and 1 for ultrasound); no significant group differences across modalities (p = 0.368), and high internal consistency (α > 0.85) were observed.

links.outcome: Factual accuracy, completeness, and potential harm of simplified reports by BI-RADS category, rated by radiologists
links.effect: High factual accuracy (median 2), completeness (median 2), low harm (median 5); BI-RADS 0, 1, 2 reports accurately explained, while BI-RADS 3-6 reports were challenging.
links.quote: BI-RADS 0, 1, and 2 reports were accurately explained, while BI-RADS 3-6 reports were challenging.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, potential harm, and lay comprehension of ChatGPT-4o simplified breast imaging reports without testing a specific deployment practice or comparing safeguards.
